description_sq:
Per shitje 2+1, kati i 3 banimi pallati i ri me ashensor. Siperfaqa neto 94.5 , bruto 103. 
Pallati 7 katesh, hyrje nga rruga kryesore. 
Shkalla me ndricim natyrale. 
I veshur me sistem kapot. 
Mundësi ndarje ne 2 Apartamente. Shumë e përshtatshme edhe per aktivitetet biznesi. Me pamje jug perëndim. 
Adresa afer Hotel Mondial, mbi BKT.
Cmimi 258000 euro!
description_en: For sale 2+1, 3rd floor, new residential building with elevator. Net area 94.5, gross 103. 7-storey building, entrance from the main road. Staircase with natural light. Dressed with capot system. Possibility of sharing in 2 apartments. Very suitable for business activities. Facing south west. Address near Hotel Mondial, above BKT. The price is 258,000 euros!
